questions.q: Which Polish Pope led the Catholic Church from 1978 to 2005?
questions.why: He was born Karol Wojtyła.

questions.q: Which invasion on 1 September 1939 began the Second World War?
questions.why: Britain and France then declared war.

questions.q: Which 1683 battle saw Polish King Jan III Sobieski relieve a besieged city?
questions.why: His winged hussars charged the Ottomans.

questions.q: Which 1410 battle saw Poland and Lithuania defeat the Teutonic Knights?
questions.why: It is one of medieval Europe's largest battles.

questions.q: Which union joined Poland and Lithuania in 1569?
questions.why: It created the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

questions.q: Which uprising of 1944 fought the Germans in the capital?
questions.why: The city was then largely destroyed.

questions.q: In which year did Poland regain independence after the First World War?
questions.why: 11 November is Independence Day.

questions.q: Which constitution of 1791 was Europe's first modern written one?
questions.why: 3 May is a national holiday.

questions.q: Which Polish city was called Danzig and was a 'free city' between the wars?
questions.why: It is a Baltic port.

questions.q: Who led Poland to independence in 1918 and won the 1920 war with Soviet Russia?
questions.why: The 1920 victory is called the 'Miracle on the Vistula'.

questions.q: Which former royal capital has Wawel Castle?
questions.why: Its old town is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: What is the capital of Poland?
questions.why: Its old town was rebuilt after the war.

questions.q: Which river flows through Warsaw and Kraków?
questions.why: It is Poland's longest river.

questions.q: Which sea lies along Poland's north coast?
questions.why: Gdańsk and Gdynia are on it.

questions.q: Which mountains form Poland's southern border with Slovakia?
questions.why: Zakopane is the main resort.

questions.q: Which Polish striker scored 41 Bundesliga goals in one season?
questions.why: He broke Gerd Müller's record in 2021.

questions.q: Which Polish tennis player won four French Open titles?
questions.why: She also won Wimbledon in 2025.

questions.q: Which composer of piano music was born near Warsaw in 1810?
questions.why: Warsaw's airport is named after him.

questions.q: Which Polish writer won the 2018 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: She wrote 'Flights'.

questions.q: Which underground salt mine near Kraków has chapels carved from salt?
questions.why: It is one of the first UNESCO sites.

questions.q: Which forest is home to Europe's largest herd of wild bison?
questions.why: It is shared with Belarus.

questions.q: Which Polish astronomer said the Earth goes around the Sun?
questions.why: His book was published in 1543.

questions.q: Which Polish-born scientist won two Nobel Prizes?
questions.why: She was born in Warsaw.

questions.q: Which trade union led by Lech Wałęsa challenged communism?
questions.why: It began at the Gdańsk shipyard in 1980.

questions.q: Which Nazi camp in southern Poland became a symbol of the Holocaust?
questions.why: It is now a museum and memorial.

questions.q: Which filled dumplings are a Polish favourite?
questions.why: They can be filled with potato, cheese or meat.

questions.q: What is Poland's currency?
questions.why: Its name means 'golden'.

questions.q: Which sour rye soup is served at Easter?
questions.why: It is often served in a bread bowl.

questions.q: Which hunter's stew is made with cabbage and meat?
questions.why: It is often called the national dish.

questions.q: Which castle near Gdańsk is the world's largest by land area?
questions.why: The Teutonic Knights built it.
